data.street_address: 0 Street level, Station, Unit 13-15, Canary Wharf DLR

description.text:
Pesky things those noodles; they twist and turn when you poke at them and stick together like glue when you try and break them apart; a little bit like our family here at Chopstix! And we love them!  

We’ve loved them since the early days in Camden market just like we love them now in our Westfield store. If we could fill the world with noodles we would! Noodles are cool, noodles are quirky, and noodles have helped us become the largest Asian inspired quick serve restaurant in the UK; no mean feat for the little guy! Belief in our noodles have helped us create our Chopstix family and inspired the simple foundations that we’ve built the brand upon.
